about.forewordText: It is with great humility and sincerity that we present the profile of the Buhary (Janaza) Funeral Welfare Society, a community-based organization dedicated to serving the Muslim residents of the Buhary Jummah Mosque area. Since its founding in 2023, our Society has strived to provide essential services with dignity, especially in moments of grief and loss. Our mission has been simple yet profound: to stand with our community when they need us the most.
about.visionText: To be the leading community funeral support service in the region, upholding Islamic values, compassion, and dignity for every individual.
about.missionItem1: To provide efficient and respectful funeral services.
about.missionItem2: To maintain a clean and accessible cemetery.
about.missionItem3: To offer dry ration and welfare support to the needy.
about.missionItem4: To create a network of active and committed members.
about.missionItem5: To promote unity and brotherhood within the community.
about.value1Desc: Every life matters, and every loss is respected.
about.value2Desc: We serve not for profit, but for the pleasure of Allah.
about.value3Desc: Transparent operations and sincere efforts define us.
about.value4Desc: Our strength is in our togetherness.
about.value5Desc: Every member has a voice and every rupee is accounted for.
about.historyP1: The year 2023 marked a significant turning point for the Buhary Mosque community. Observing the logistical difficulties families faced during funerals—ranging from preparation of the deceased to burial procedures and cemetery management—a small team of community elders and youth came together to form a structured organization.
about.historyP2: With collective consultation (shura), the Buhary (Janaza) Funeral Welfare Society was officially formed and registered. A membership drive was launched, a basic constitution was drafted, and initial contributions were collected. This foundational year saw the Society take on its first few funeral arrangements, setting the standard of compassionate, organized community care.
about.structureDesc: The Society is structured to ensure accountability, active volunteer participation, and organized response during emergencies:
about.membershipDesc: To promote affordability and inclusivity, the Society operates on a transparent dual payment system. Each member is issued an ID number and contributions are recorded in monthly ledgers:
about.registrationText: Registered with the Divisional Secretariat under registration number DS/TH/SS/VSSO/2023/01, operating in the Buhary Jummah Mosque Mahallah Area, Mullipothanai, Sri Lanka.

servicesPage.subtitle: Guided by Islamic principles and community solidarity, we provide round-the-clock funeral assistance, environmental cemetery upkeep, and essential family food welfare.
servicesPage.service1Desc: The cornerstone of our mission. When a death occurs in our community, our dedicated team assists the family immediately through every step of the funeral process with respect and care.
servicesPage.service1Item1: Arranging Janazah prayers with mosque imams and elders
servicesPage.service1Item2: Ritual Ghusl (washing) and Kafan (shrouding) conducted according to Sunnah
servicesPage.service1Item3: Transporting the deceased from residence or hospital to mosque and burial ground (including long-distance & far away transportation across Sri Lanka)
servicesPage.service1Item4: Assisting grieving families with burial documentation and cemetery arrangements
servicesPage.service1Item5: Ensuring respectful, timely, and organized burials
servicesPage.service2Desc: Maintaining a dignified, clean, and accessible final resting place for our community is an ongoing collective responsibility.
servicesPage.service2Item1: Clearing overgrown vegetation, brush, and waste regularly
servicesPage.service2Item2: Ensuring walkways and access paths are level, safe, and clean
servicesPage.service2Item3: Maintaining signage, grave demarcations, and boundary fences
servicesPage.service2Item4: Installed on-site water supply facilities and shade tents for visitors
servicesPage.service2Item5: Coordination with local authorities for road access and infrastructure improvements
servicesPage.service3Desc: In response to economic hardship and immediate family emergencies, the society distributes basic and essential living necessities, nutritious food packs, and seasonal relief supplies.
servicesPage.service3Item1: Prioritizing widows, orphans, elderly persons, and vulnerable families
servicesPage.service3Item2: Distribution of basic and essential living necessities to deserving households
servicesPage.service3Item3: Annual Udhiyah (Qurbani) fresh meat distribution for widows and needy families
servicesPage.service3Item4: Seasonal relief initiatives including Ramadan Iftar and food support
servicesPage.service3Item5: Dignified, confidential doorstep delivery for families experiencing hardship
servicesPage.service4Desc: Building an educated, prepared network of youth and volunteers capable of performing funeral rites and comforting families.
servicesPage.service4Item1: Conducting practical Islamic funeral education sessions on Ghusl and Kafan
servicesPage.service4Item2: Training volunteers on providing emotional support to grieving families
servicesPage.service4Item3: Instructing in health, safety, and hygiene protocols for funeral attendants
servicesPage.service4Item4: Volunteer appreciation sessions to foster brotherhood and dedication
servicesPage.service5Desc: Organizing collective volunteer campaigns to clear overgrowth, level access paths, clean mosque surroundings, and preserve the sanctity and hygiene of community cemetery grounds.
servicesPage.service5Item1: Periodic environmental clearance of the 1.5-acre Mahallah cemetery grounds
servicesPage.service5Item2: Clearing wild shrubs, fallen branches, and leveling safe pedestrian walkways
servicesPage.service5Item3: Monsoon flood drainage clearance and community vector disease prevention
servicesPage.service5Item4: Mobilizing youth volunteers to instill lifelong civic responsibility and community brotherhood
servicesPage.service6Title: F. Orphan Care & Vulnerable Family Sponsorship
servicesPage.service6Desc: Providing sustained care, educational stipends, school essentials, and household sustenance to fatherless children and vulnerable single-mother families in our Mahallah.
servicesPage.service6Item1: Education support funds, stationery packs, and school uniform allowances
servicesPage.service6Item2: Basic and essential needs assistance for destitute single-mother families and vulnerable households
servicesPage.service6Item3: Youth mentorship, Islamic character building, and vocational pathway guidance
servicesPage.service6Item4: Confidential, transparent family vetting conducted respectfully by executive committee
servicesPage.service7Title: G. Disaster Relief & Emergency Crisis Response
servicesPage.service7Desc: Rapid-response humanitarian assistance deployed during seasonal flash floods, severe droughts, health epidemics, and unexpected household crises in Mullipothanai.
servicesPage.service7Item1: Deployment of emergency cooked meals and safe potable drinking water during flood displacement
servicesPage.service7Item2: Distribution of emergency tarpaulins, dry rations, and family sanitary hygiene packs
servicesPage.service7Item3: Coordinating field logistics alongside District Disaster Management Centers and public health inspectors
servicesPage.service7Item4: Post-calamity clean-up, home recovery assistance, and rebuilding support for affected families
servicesPage.emergencyDesc: Our funeral management team is on call round the clock to support families upon bereavement. Call our emergency hotline directly for immediate assistance.

achievementsPage.longTerm1: Construct a dedicated ritual Ghusl room facility near the cemetery.
achievementsPage.longTerm2: Purchase an official society-owned funeral hearse transport vehicle.

privacyPage.subtitle: How Buhary Janaza Welfare Society collects, safeguards, and uses information provided by community members.
privacyPage.section1Body: Buhary Janaza Welfare Society collects personal information strictly for genuine welfare services, including funeral coordination, membership directory records, subscription tracking, and emergency communications. We collect only what is strictly necessary: names, contact phone numbers, residential areas, and household sizes.
privacyPage.section2Body: We respect your dignity and privacy. Personal details submitted via this website are never sold, traded, or shared with commercial entities or unauthorized third parties. Access to member records is restricted strictly to authorized executive committee officers (President, Secretary, and Treasurer).
privacyPage.section3Body: Photographs published on this website document public community activities (e.g. shramadhana cleanups, humanitarian distributions). In accordance with society guidelines, photos highlighting identifiable community members, women, or minors require explicit consent and administrative verification prior to publication.
privacyPage.section4Body: You have the right to request access to your submitted details, request corrections, or request removal from our contact lists. For any inquiries regarding data protection, please contact the society secretary at mbjwsociety@gmail.com or visit the society office at the 95th Buhary Jummah Mosque, Mullipothanai.
